args.summary: reverse the pocket direction so it cuts into the plate

ops.reason: the pocket removed nothing. It was built on the XY plane, whose normal is +Z, and PartDesign::Pocket cuts in the direction OPPOSITE the profile normal by default (-Z). The plate sits on the +Z side of that plane, so the cut went into empty space and the feature silently did nothing. Reversing it makes the cut go up through the 8mm plate.

args.message: slot now cuts through the plate
